verdict.rationale: Workable's pricing page lists a first-party "Custom report builder", which is the product's own reporting capability for funnel analytics. The evidence is a single bare mention and never names the specific metrics or the per-role/per-team breakdown the story asks for. The stages, events, and offer API endpoints are only building blocks a developer could use to compute such metrics, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reports, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rates, per-role/team segmentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team
